Shows how busy your processor, graphics card and memory are, and your graphics card's temperature, speed, power and fan. It only reads: it never changes fan speed, performance or power. It reads only while this page is open or another app asks, and stops when nothing looks. Processor temperature isn't shown: Windows doesn't share it without an extra driver. System temperature is the hottest board or chassis zone Windows reports.
Updates once a second while this page is open.
